ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a triangle, and there are identical tick marks on the two slanted sides, indicating that these two slanted sides are equal. The whole base is labeled 12, and the right base angle is labeled 60°. From the vertex to the base a pink dashed line is drawn, labeled h, and there is a right-angle mark at the bottom, indicating that h is the altitude perpendicular to the base. Reasoning: Since the two slanted sides are equal, this triangle is an isosceles triangle, so the two base angles are equal. The right base angle is 60°, so the left base angle is also 60°. The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, and the vertex angle is also 60°, so this triangle is an equilateral triangle. The altitude of an equilateral triangle bisects the base, so the base 12 is divided into two segments, each segment being 6. Take one of the right triangles; one segment of the base is 6, the height is h, and the base angle is 60°. From tan(60°)=h/6, and tan(60°)=√3, so h=6√3.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as an isosceles triangle: the two slanted sides have matching tick marks, the whole base is labeled 12, the right base angle is 60°, and the dashed segment h is an altitude perpendicular to the base. 推理：由于两条斜边相等，这个三角形是等腰三角形，因此两个底角相等。右底角是 60°，所以左底角也是 60°。三角形内角和为 180°，顶角也为 60°，所以该三角形是等边三角形。等边三角形的高会平分底边，因此底边 12 被分成两段，每段为 6。取其中一个直角三角形，底边一段为 6，高为 h，底角为 60°。由 tan(60°)=h/6，且 tan(60°)=√3，所以 h=6√3。
